order: This change tightens launch discipline for the cross-vendor launchers. Every one of them now starts from the repository root rather than an arbitrary working directory, so relative paths resolve consistently regardless of where the parent process was invoked from, and each launcher's output then goes into the shared scratch directory instead of scattering across the tree. The review warmup step pins to a known checkout for every run, so it exercises exactly the state the review will actually run against rather than something stale or unrelated. The same three fixes apply across all three files in the set, the base executor, the heavy executor, and the reviewer launcher script, so their startup behavior stays consistent with one another. Each script's existing command-line interface stays the same throughout, since the startup and warmup discipline are the only pieces that change in this pass, and every other behavior carries over precisely as it did before.
claims: Launch discipline was fixed across exactly three launcher scripts altogether, and each one now starts from the repository root alone, never from anywhere else. Each script also writes its own output solely to the scratch directory, and pins the warmup to the checkout under test rather than an arbitrary one. The three files changed by 90 added lines and 24 removed lines in total, covering the base executor, the heavy executor, and the reviewer launchers, all kept consistent with one another.
